scripts.run.sh:
set -eu
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq pulseaudio pulseaudio-utils >/dev/null
pulseaudio --system -n --disallow-exit --exit-idle-time=-1 --log-level=debug --log-target=file:/probe/out/pulse.log --load="module-null-sink sink_name=lunar rate=48000 channels=2" --load="module-native-protocol-unix auth-anonymous=1 socket=/tmp/pa.sock" -D
export PULSE_SERVER=unix:/tmp/pa.sock PULSE_SOURCE=lunar.monitor PLAYWRIGHT_DIR=/pw BROWSER=webkit
node -e "console.log('playwright', require('/pw/node_modules/playwright/package.json').version)" > /probe/out/versions.log
pulseaudio --version >> /probe/out/versions.log
ls /ms-playwright >> /probe/out/versions.log
pactl info >> /probe/out/versions.log
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max >> /probe/out/versions.log
DEBUG=pw:browser timeout 120 node /probe/sim/web/test/audio-loopback.mjs /probe/sim/web/www /probe/out/audio 30 > /probe/out/audio.log 2>&1
# Four fixed fresh starts after loopback, then two starts after a five-second idle.
# These are observations, never a retry that turns a failure into a pass.
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  if [ "$i" = 5 ]; then sleep 5; fi
  mkdir -p /probe/out/startup-$i
  (
    while :; do
      date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%N
      pactl --format=json list sink-inputs
      cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat
      sleep .1
    done
  ) > /probe/out/startup-$i/pulse-inputs.log 2>&1 & observer=$!
  date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%N > /probe/out/startup-$i/times.log
  DEBUG=pw:browser GST_DEBUG=audiobasesink:6,pulse:6,webkitaudiodestination:6,webkitaudiosrc:6 GST_DEBUG_FILE=/probe/out/startup-$i/gstreamer.log timeout 45 node /probe/sim/web/test/startup-probe.mjs /probe/sim/web/www /probe/out/startup-$i > /probe/out/startup-$i/browser.log 2>&1 || echo $? > /probe/out/startup-$i/exit-status
  date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%N >> /probe/out/startup-$i/times.log
  kill "$observer"; wait "$observer" || :
done
pactl --format=json list sinks > /probe/out/final-sinks.json
chown -R "$(stat -c %u:%g /probe)" /probe/out

limitsOfEvidence: Main-thread clock samples do not directly timestamp AudioWorklet receipt or processing.
Silent sampler adds five seconds before encoder input and perturbs timing; it is not the unchanged editor-ui acceptance run.
Pulse/GStreamer and quota warnings also occur in passing runs; they do not prove causation.
Exact CI failure used a rebuilt module; this LAN experiment uses recorded baseline module SHA.
